sampling: Take first 100 eligible paths in chronological draw order per split; eligibility uses ONLY decoded t=0 distance>=1.0. Keep raw batches and exclusions.
reset_rng_note: New simulator resets per draw; imagination RNG explicit, simulator reset RNG not completely controlled by recorded imagination seeds.
primary_event: All 64 real model transitions satisfy P1/P2, endpoint V<eta, and decoded goal reached within 64 steps
decision: Compare individual one-sided 95% CP lower bound of the primary event with .95
inference: Assumes iid same-distribution draws conditional on initial eligibility; other reported bounds are individual, not simultaneous. No real-world guarantee.
sequencing: V frozen before calibration; prediction persisted before test; no refitting
